item.title: SEC cancels Aug. 14 Reg Crypto meeting, postponing its digital-asset offering framework proposal to an unspecified later date.
SEC delays tokenization 'innovation exemption' after White House and Wall Street raise concerns over legal footing and market impact.
CFTC chair says agency will finalize crypto rules before administration ends regardless of whether CLARITY Act passes Congress.
U.S. spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs draw over $1B in weekly net inflows, best week since April; BlackRock's IBIT captures $693M.
U.S. regulators miss GENIUS Act's July 18 deadline for final stablecoin rules, compressing the issuer implementation window to 2027.
Banks and crypto firms clash over whether GENIUS Act permits interest-bearing stablecoins; joint KYC comment period closes Aug. 21.
FDIC proposes AML and customer-identification requirements for stablecoin issuers implementing the GENIUS Act framework.
Up to 20 banks and large tech firms are queued to issue stablecoins under the GENIUS Act, per a federally chartered custodian.
Approximately 594 BTC ($38M) drained from about 500 wallets after a key-generation flaw discovered in Coldcard hardware wallets.
Basel Committee cryptoasset standard, effective Jan. 1 2026, assigns 1,250% risk weight to unbacked crypto on bank balance sheets.
FATF warns stablecoins now dominate illicit crypto transaction volume, urging jurisdictions to close Travel Rule enforcement gaps.
Crypto hack losses total $972M across a record 207 incidents in H1 2026, down from prior-year pace despite highest-ever attack count.
North Korea-linked actors account for 66% of global crypto hack losses in H1 2026, up from 64% in the same period last year.
CFTC Innovation Advisory Committee holds Aug. 20 open meeting on crypto, AI, and prediction market regulations.
JPMorgan's Kinexys platform processes tokenized collateral and blockchain-based settlement transactions for institutional clients.
